LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency, part of Strand 6 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why is intonation and pace in reading important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm intonation and pace in reading,

2. watch a video recording of a conversation on the theme,

3. observe the use of intonation and pace in the conversation,

4. team up to collect texts from print and non-print sources based on the theme,

5. take turns to read the texts with correct intonation and pace,

6. team up to conduct a speed reading competition using correct intonation and pace.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm intonation and pace in reading,
2. watch a video recording of a conversation on the theme,
3. observe the use of intonation and pace in the conversation,
4. team up to collect texts from print and non-print sources based on the theme,
5. take turns to read the texts with correct intonation and pace,
6. team up to conduct a speed reading competition using correct intonation and pace.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner engages actively when teaming up to conduct a speed

reading competition using correct intonation and pace.

• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner engages with digital content when watching a video recording of a

conversation on the theme.

34

Values:
• Love: This is developed as the learner collects texts from print and non-print sources based on the theme with peers.

• Respect: This is enhanced as the learner displays patience when taking turns to read the texts with correct intonation,

pace and speed.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Inter-ethnic cohesion: This is promoted as the learner accommodates other’s views irrespective of their position or ideology.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to learn the concept of health and diseases in the theme and relate it to similar concepts in Agriculture.
